newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO TURNS TO BROTHER EMILIO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SANCHEZ VICARIO TURNS TO BROTHER EMILIO.

text.p: Spanish number one Arantxa Sanchez Vicario has appointed her brother Emilio as her new coach in a bid to resurrect her career and help her to challenge Steffi Graf and Martina Hingis.
"To be number one again I need someone who knows me," said Sanchez Vicario.
"He's been alongside me in several grand slam finals and his presence always gave me confidence."
Emilio Sanchez, a former Spanish number one who takes over from Australian Mervyn Rose, will continue to play on the men's circuit despite his new job, although he will play in fewer tournaments.
"I had already decided to reduce my professional obligations," he said.
"She must improve her serve and positioning on court."
He said the French Open was his sister's main objective this season.
After a brief spell at the top of the world rankings in 1994, Arantxa was recently beaten in the third round of the Australian Open.
She is now ranked fourth in the world behind Germany's Graf, 16-year-old Swiss Hingis, who won the Australian Open, and Jana Novotna of the Czech Republic.
